# Onjaal

> Onjaal builds business software for growing businesses in India, starting with Onjaal HRMS: employee records, attendance, leave and approvals in one workspace. Onjaal HRMS is available now. Onjaal CRM, ERP and Accounts are in development, with no announced release dates.

This file is a plain-language guide to the public pages of onjaal.com. It is informational only. Published prices exclude applicable taxes. Statutory payroll and compliance scope is confirmed with the company during a demo. Contact: tech@onjaal.com

## Product
- [Onjaal HRMS](https://onjaal.com/products/hrms/): what the HR product does, its FAQ, and an interactive preview that uses fictional sample data
- [The Onjaal suite](https://onjaal.com/products/): the available product and the products in development

## Pricing and contact
- [Pricing](https://onjaal.com/pricing/): published plans (Free, Standard, Premium, Enterprise), one-time services and an estimator
- [Contact](https://onjaal.com/contact/): request free access, a demo or a proposal
- [Help and support](https://onjaal.com/support/): how to reach the team and where to find answers

## Company and trust
- [About](https://onjaal.com/about/): approach, principles and roadmap
- [Trust and data](https://onjaal.com/security/): what the website and preview do with data, and questions answered in writing before purchase
- [Privacy Policy](https://onjaal.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://onjaal.com/terms/)
